keyEvents.text: Ante Roguljic (Borac Banja Luka) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Mjällby 0, Borac Banja Luka 0.
Second Half begins Mjällby 0, Borac Banja Luka 0.
Goal! Mjällby 1, Borac Banja Luka 0. Jacob Bergström (Mjällby) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Mjällby. Mads Enggård replaces Romeo Leandersson.
Amer Hiros (Borac Banja Luka) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Borac Banja Luka. David Vukovic replaces Luka Juricic because of an injury.
Substitution, Mjällby. Áki Samuelsen replaces Jeppe Kjær.
Substitution, Mjällby. Ian Hoffmann replaces Max Nielsen.
Substitution, Borac Banja Luka. Stojan Vranjes replaces Stefan Savic.
Goal! Mjällby 2, Borac Banja Luka 0. Mads Enggård (Mjällby) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Áki Samuelsen.
Substitution, Borac Banja Luka. Dani Romera replaces Matej Deket.
Second Half ends, Mjällby 2, Borac Banja Luka 0.
